record_title: Exact subalgebra commutativity degrees for finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
provenance: An all-rank symplectic enumeration extends the explicit rank-one Heisenberg computation in arXiv:2609.19086v1 and transfers, for odd primes, to exponent-p extraspecial groups via the Lazard correspondence.
limitations: Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source paper, its cited subgroup-commutativity literature, targeted searches for Heisenberg/extraspecial formulas, and standard finite symplectic counts were checked. Older subgroup-lattice literature on extraspecial groups may contain an equivalent enumeration in different language. No independent validation is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exhaustive verification for H_2 over F_2 and F_3 using only the Python standard library.
